player_intent: Replace the U-shaped reticle with the SOCOM II video reference: four chartreuse cardinal ticks, a tiny center point, and a faint shaded central disc.
acceptance_rule: The combat reticle draws four outward-facing cardinal ticks with symmetric gaps driven by the existing saved weapon spread profile. Movement does not independently lengthen the side ticks. A tiny point and fixed-size faint disc remain on authoritative camera aim while existing cosmetic shot feedback may move the ticks. Target colors, hit confirmation, and interaction brackets remain available. This is reference-inspired presentation, not a change to shot spread, gravity, damage, recoil mechanics, or weapon balance.

nodes.role: Consumes the saved per-weapon reticle profile and draws four cardinal ticks with a central point and faint disc around the canonical camera aim point.

must_not_change: SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
server shot direction, spread, hit classification, damage, and networking authority
weapon fire cadence and accepted-shot ownership
visual_check: Run res://main.tscn through the rendered integration with --capture-reticle. Inspect /private/tmp/socom-ballistic-reference-reticle.png: four cardinal ticks, tiny center point, faint fixed disc, no U-shaped arc. Geometry tests cover 16:9 and 4:3, expansion and recovery, target/interact/hit feedback, and aim-center preservation. Compare against the user video at 0:00, 0:05, and 24:17; exact original-game timing is not claimed.
